set.body: Source: validated review of the effectagram usability report dated 2026-08-13. Execute in dependency order and treat existing issue records as implementation children rather than duplicating them. 1) Input and coercion safety: fix and regression-test cross_partitions(relation_fit), as.matrix() for public view classes, and the invalid noise_precision(diag(...)) error-message recipe. Reconcile with R1 and bd-01KZYDTPTS6QPHCM07P1PPH396, bd-01KZY99TXMHQYMAYA4VQDZCWFD, and bd-01KZYJAQ7Y06F5C1P7KG6MAJE4. 2) Finish and commit the onboarding slice: planted-signal generator, question-first vignette, API tiers, estimand formula, and honest literature boundaries. Reconcile with bd-01KZZYK2C750EASSFKB4YS398Z and R2/R3. 3) Regenerate Haxby timing and cost prose from one authoritative artifact; preserve the correct parity attribution (independent loop 1.33e-15, rMVPA 8.88e-16), correct 12 runs versus 8 conditions, and remove obsolete 9 s/node, 22-minute, and 90-minute figures. 4) Repair advanced journeys: expose required setup in evidence-pairing.Rmd, state that measurement bridges have no exported consumer, and document one complete neuroim2 round trip. Reconcile with bd-01KZY94REFFH9DQDJG7TD2J7XJ, bd-01KZYS7XH6G12QV8EYT561EPS3, and bd-01KZYPC2TDB85HXP6KRABDXFQY. 5) Only after 1-4, design the unified verb path so relation/frame/plan ergonomics improve without collapsing fixed versus learned metric capabilities, training policy, error-channel requirements, or uncertainty scope. Acceptance: all implementation is committed; focused regression tests cover the three reproduced API failures; README and both vignettes execute; the Haxby and public-scale claims are regenerated from versioned artifacts; documentation distinguishes algebraic exactness from floating-point tolerance; all referenced Mote children are reconciled before this task closes.
set.title: Close the post-review adoption-readiness sequence
